terms.context: A single note the user adds to a block and PlanCake writes into the Markdown file
terms.notes: Always 'заметка', feminine noun; declines normally across cases (заметки, заметку, заметок...). Never 'комментарий' or 'примечание'

terms.context: A paragraph, list item, heading, table row or code block that a note attaches to
terms.notes: Generic term covering paragraph/heading/list item/table row/code block collectively, as in 'следующий блок' (next block)

terms.context: The panel listing all notes in the file, with the 'The notes list' section heading
terms.notes: Consistent throughout: heading, menu items (Список заметок, Расширить/Сузить список заметок) and prose all use this phrase

terms.context: Bottom bar showing confirmation messages such as 'Note added'
Top bar of the window holding the menus
Section heading 'Using a screen reader' and general accessibility prose
terms.notes: Literally 'program of screen access'; this is the established Russian term, never 'скринридер' or a transliteration

terms.context: The note markers such as [usernote]/[/usernote] wrapping a note's text in the file
terms.notes: Used for both the opening and closing marker (открывающий/закрывающий маркер)

terms.context: A Markdown checklist item, as in 'Mark this task as done?'
terms.notes: Feminine noun; section heading is 'Отметка выполненных задач' (Marking tasks done)

terms.context: Setting controlling what voice a screen reader uses to read the plan, independent of the interface language
terms.notes: Capitalized as a settings/menu label, matching the manual's rendering

terms.context: Setting controlling the language of menus, dialogs and messages
terms.notes: Capitalized as a settings/menu label, matching the manual's rendering

terms.context: Generic word for a dialog box, e.g. the Open dialog or a Yes/No confirmation
terms.notes: Masculine noun; used both generically ('в остальных диалогах') and in specific dialog names ('диалог заметки', 'диалог открытия')

terms.context: The two buttons in a Yes/No confirmation dialog
terms.notes: Bare 'Да' and 'Нет', bolded in the manual; not 'ОК' (OK is a separate button used in non-confirmation dialogs)

terms.context: Windows Explorer, e.g. dragging a file from it or its 'Copy as path' command
terms.notes: Capitalized as a proper name; declines across cases (Проводника, Проводнике)

terms.context: The Windows Downloads folder where PlanCake saves files opened from a link
terms.notes: The folder's name as Windows shows it, in « » because it does not decline with 'папка' ('в вашу папку «Загрузки»'); without the quotes, decline it instead: 'папка загрузок'

terms.context: Launching PlanCake from the Windows Start menu
terms.notes: The menu's name in « », as with every name after a generic noun: меню «Файл», кнопка «Отмена», диалог «Добавить заметку»

terms.context: The Windows Command Prompt / command line, e.g. running plancake.exe from it
terms.notes: Lowercase; the manual uses the same phrase for both the specific Command Prompt app and the generic 'command line' concept, and does not distinguish them

terms.context: File Explorer's 'Copy as path' command, which adds quotation marks around the copied path
terms.notes: Capitalized as a command name, matching the manual's rendering

terms.context: A GitHub issue, as in 'paste them into a new issue on PlanCake's GitHub page'
terms.notes: Neuter noun ('новое обращение'). Not the Latin 'issue', which a Russian voice mangles; not 'задача', which is the glossary's word for a task; not 'проблема'

terms.context: GitHub's 'Raw' link/button for viewing a file's raw content
terms.notes: Left untranslated, in Latin script, bolded as a UI label name
